notes.title: Tank Brawl 2: Armor Fury is available.
notes.content:
Co-op and PvP vehicular combat with RPG upgrade system and fully destructible world. You can control both land and sea vehicles or even a Mecha, which can be combined with 4 drivers to create different classes to fight a fast paced battle with monstrous tanks, trains and battle cruisers!
You can play co-op in the main campaign or battling each other in PvP arenas.
The world has a balanced mix of platforming, shooting and Metroidvania adventure. You will need to navigate tricky terrains, avoid being tricked by some smart imposter, dodge enemy ramming tanks, run away from hordes of suicide bombers, avoid being squashed by falling rocks or helping your friendly army win a battle.
There is also a solo survival mode where you compete for top spots in the world leaderboard.

Key features:
Up to 4 players online, shared screen, split screen co-op.
Fun focused Player versus Player battles
Varied PvP arenas includes Japanese garden, lush beach island, Jungle military base.
Metroidvania style adventure.
Land and sea battles
Combine vehicles and drivers with unique upgrade paths.
Fully destructible world (Wrecking houses, trees, fences, props .etc.)
5 vehicles and 4 drivers includes: Tank, Giant mech, Mobile Artillery, Boat, Jeep.
Balanced mix of fighting and platforming gameplay.
Continuous world with no loading screen.
Tugs a heavy train using your tank, Riding on trains, surfing the sea with high speed boat.
Your weapons: Hammer, death ray, mech katana, blue flame thrower, missile barrage .etc.
Enemies includes suicide bombers, battle cruisers, trains, ramming tank, laser tank, trucks carrying troops .etc.
Survival mode with leaderboard.

notes.title: Survival score reset
notes.content:
Hello,
We will make a change to the survival mode game play where the maximum number of enemy tanks on the screen has been raised from 20 to 100. This is to prevent the score inflation where you can go on forever. So together with this change, it makes sense that we are going to reset the score board for survival when the patch is live IN 1 OR 2 WEEK. I hope this doesn't upset anyone, especially Ranzou who is now on top of the leaderboard with 250,000 score.
Please let us know what you think.

notes.title: Editor and Community maps short preview
notes.content:
The level editor and community maps feature is very close to be finished, and it will be released soon [b]FREE OF CHARGE[/b]. Below is a quick previews of what it offers.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/6085300f6f31ae5e0c80585ba06c19a88619c77d.jpg[/img]

You can save and play your map locally or from within the editor you can publish your map directly to Steam Community Workshop and others can download and enjoy your map.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/516852dc0558d02f30ce9751dbdf412b4b91458e.jpg[/img]

We triy to balance between a powerful and yet easy to tool use so came up with the following control scheme:
Left Click on the item palette to choose the object are going to place in the level.
Left Click on an empty space will add an object to the level.
Left Click on an existing object in the level will bring up its property windows
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/234809d10e3bdca17a7e9de5bf542c016f556ce4.jpg[/img]

Right Click on an empty space will change the rotation of the object that you are going to place in the level
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/08e0add2d7d3a2ffcc47d00bedbc2008a544e165.jpg[/img]

Camera movement is controlled by: Up, down, left, right button or move the mouse to edge of the screen or dragging using mouse buttons.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/d027a68b4e8ca0be1f93df22b771652dd2ef8fa1.jpg[/img]

At this point we really want to know what you guys like to have in the level editor so please drop us a comment. Thanks.

notes.title: Fix for crash during launch
notes.content:
On some machine, this may happen. This is most likely because some old graphics card doesn't support DX11 properly. So you need to manually force the game to use dx9 by launching the game using "DX9 Windowed" or "DX9 Fullscreen" option. Then disable post processing in option menu. 

Sorry for any inconvinient
